title: Tag job photos and filter by tag

steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: Tags make job photos easy to find later. Here is how to tag several at once.

steps.caption: Open the job
steps.narration: Open the job from the Pipeline. Here, the Kane hardwood job.

steps.caption: Open feed
steps.narration: Then Open feed, for the job's photos with all the tools.

steps.caption: Tags on a photo
steps.narration: A photo's tag shows in its corner.

steps.caption: Select
steps.narration: To tag several photos together, choose Select.

steps.caption: Tags
steps.narration: In the bar that appears, choose Tags.

steps.caption: A new tag
steps.narration: Pick a tag from the list, or type a new one.

steps.caption: Add the new tag
steps.narration: Choose Add, and the new tag is made and ticked.

steps.caption: Add to the photos
steps.narration: Then choose Add, to put the tag on both photos.

steps.caption: Two tags
steps.narration: Each of them now carries two tags.

steps.caption: Done
steps.narration: Choose Done to leave select mode.

steps.caption: Filter: Tags
steps.narration: To find tagged photos later, choose Tags, beside the search box.

steps.caption: The filtered feed
steps.narration: The feed now shows only the two photos with that tag.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: JobCam in the left menu has the same tools, across all your jobs.

youtube.title: How to tag job photos and filter by tag | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Organise job-site photos in ConstructHUB JobCam. Select several photos, add an existing tag or make a new one, and filter the feed by tag to find them again. Recorded in a demo workspace; the pictures are placeholder cards made for the demo.
